tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: List active countries, airports, services, and representative providers.

tools.name: list_providers
tools.description: List transfer or vehicle-rental providers by two-letter country code.

tools.name: list_destinations
tools.description: List every published transfer route with exact route codes, airports, landing pages, booking URLs, pricing basis, and transaction rules.

tools.name: get_destination_details
tools.description: Get one route's provider, directions, prices, vehicle classes, required fields, quote template, landing page, booking URL, and payment boundary.

tools.name: preview_transfer_quote
tools.description: Calculate a non-binding, non-persisted transfer quote. This tool cannot hold, book, message, cancel, or charge.

tools.name: preview_private_driver_quote
tools.description: Calculate a non-binding, non-persisted private-driver price range. Review the saved quote for payment eligibility and supplier-assignment status.

tools.name: list_rental_vehicles
tools.description: List the current published vehicle-rental fleet for an active market. Inventory is not confirmed.

tools.name: preview_rental_quote
tools.description: Calculate a non-binding, non-persisted rental quote. Availability and payment remain with the representative rental company.
